Class AUFilter

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.transport.AUFilter
public final class AUFilter extends Object
Server-side filter predicate applied to every AccessUnit before serialisation. Wire mapping matches Python ttio.transport.filters.AUFilter and ObjC TTIOAUFilter.

M89.3 added the three genomic predicates: chromosome (exact-match string), positionMin and positionMax (inclusive int64 range). The position predicates explicitly reject non-genomic AUs (spectrumClass != 5) so MS and genomic AUs in a multiplexed stream remain cleanly separable.
